seoTitle: Get Paid Daily, Weekly, or Monthly on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to set up your eBay payout schedule so earnings from Managed Payments land in your bank account daily, weekly, or monthly.
intro: eBay sellers can choose how often they receive payouts, whether that's daily, weekly, or monthly, which makes managing cash flow easier. This guide covers setting your payout schedule, linking your bank account, and tracking pending payments through Seller Hub.

steps.heading: Open the Payments section in Seller Hub
steps.body: Go to Seller Hub and access the Payments area, where you can view and manage your payout settings.

steps.heading: Choose your payout schedule
steps.body: Select whether you want to receive payouts daily, weekly, or monthly based on your cash flow needs.

steps.heading: Connect your bank account securely
steps.body: Link your bank account so funds are transferred automatically once payouts are processed.

steps.heading: Understand processing times
steps.body: Payouts are typically processed after an item is delivered or confirmed, and timing can vary depending on your schedule choice.

steps.heading: Track pending payouts and holds
steps.body: Check payment holds and pending payouts in Seller Hub so you know exactly what's expected and when.

steps.heading: Reduce delays
steps.body: Keeping your account details current and understanding eBay's Managed Payments system can help you avoid unnecessary payout delays.

faq.question: How do I change how often I get paid on eBay?
faq.answer: You can switch between daily, weekly, or monthly payouts in the Payments section of Seller Hub.

faq.question: How fast are funds processed after a sale?
faq.answer: Payouts are generally processed after an item is delivered or confirmed, with the exact timing depending on your chosen schedule.

faq.question: Can I track pending payouts?
faq.answer: Yes, Seller Hub shows pending payouts and any payment holds so you can monitor your cash flow.

faq.question: Do I need a bank account to get paid?
faq.answer: Yes, a linked and verified bank account is required to receive payouts under eBay's Managed Payments system.

faq.question: What can cause payment delays?
faq.answer: Delays can happen due to unverified bank details or account holds, so keeping your information current helps avoid them.
